Thanks for the ping — I reviewed the ProcurePlus redlines and prepared a short summary. See highlights below (full comments in attached MSA_redline_summary.docx):

1) Indemnity / liability cap
- ProcurePlus wants to remove our OSS carveout. We recommend: preserve the carveout but narrow to direct copyright/license infringement claims only; maintain a liability cap of the greater of $250k or 6 months of fees. Alternative: tie cap to annualized spend (we can accept \"cap = 12 months fees\" if legal ops confirms risk tolerance).

2) Data residency / deletion
- Their redline requests worldwide transfer rights. We can accept cross-border transfers with SOC2 controls and a data processing addendum. Require explicit deletion window for test data (30 days) and audit logging enabled.

3) Signature authority
- Single-signature by VP Finance is acceptable if ProcurePlus can provide signatory matrix and a one-time attestation letter on headed paper. For delegated signers, we need a table of authority and an email confirmation from the VP of Finance delegating to the signer.

4) PO field mapping & Ariba
- No legal blockers. Operations will need to provide a PO field spec and EDI/POAck SLA. We require PO acceptance within 5 business days for automated routing or a manual exception process.

Next steps: I propose we accept the majority of the redlines with the edits above and request ProcurePlus to: (a) confirm signatory attestation, (b) provide insurance evidence (cert of insurance), and (c) confirm whether indemnity cap should be linked to annual spend. I attached the redline summary.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- Indemnity cap: Finance prefers cap tied to 12 months of actual spend rather than a fixed dollar figure. If Redwood legal can accept a spend-tied cap we will confirm numbers.
- Signatory attestation: VP Finance will provide a one-page delegation letter and confirm the designated signer (name + email).
- Insurance + Tax: Certificate of insurance and W9 (Tax ID) are ready — I can attach them to the DocuSign envelope.
- Ariba: We can start enrollment as soon as the signature path is confirmed. Our Ariba admin (procureplus-ops@procureplus.com) would like to know the PO field names you require.

We are available for the reconciliation call on Wednesday. Please send an invite.

Elena
